_comment: Florida Department of State publishes this login for everyone on its official Data Downloads page; it is not a private credential. LeadIntel uses it to download Sunbiz bulk files from sftp.floridados.gov (HTTPS). A login saved with 'setup.ps1 -SunbizLogin' overrides it, for example if Florida changes it.
provided: 2026-11-05, by the project owner from the official page
